# The matched-pair study: same trigger, different outcome, what else was on the card (generated by analysis/pairs/run_pairs.py)

Prereg docs/experiments/tvb44_matched_pairs_prereg.md (confirmed 2026-11-02; section 12 folded). Units with an exit-only outcome: crypto 178,203 (with a T1 152,255), btc 1,403 (with a T1 1,196), es_globex_clean 4,548 (with a T1 3,402), es_rth_clean 2,842 (with a T1 2,164), es_globex_all 4,820 (with a T1 3,599), es_rth_all 4,786 (with a T1 3,652). A cell is read at 200 units (crypto), 50 (bitcoin alone), 50 (ES); smaller cells are pooled as 'other' and shown. The month side of weekly and monthly units is the unit's own trigger against the month's open (relabelled against the engine's daily-trigger label: crypto 1,971, btc 17, es_globex_clean 59, es_rth_clean 78, es_globex_all 62, es_rth_all 86). Per level: the share with a first target, the T1-reach rate OVER THE UNITS WITH ONE, the exit-only mean, each standardized to the cell sizes; the pooled high-minus-low difference is stratified by cell with a normal 95% interval. Characterization, no selector; every variable shown whether it separates or not.

## The owner's theme rule: same direction on the crypto run AND an ES clean-fill day, both intervals clear

Per variable, the pooled high-minus-low difference in T1 reach (percentage points, over the units that have a first target) on every tape; `theme` when the rule holds. A variable that separates on one tape only is a reading there, not a theme.
